name: m3-expressive
description: Build expressive, adaptive Android apps with Material 3 Expressive and Jetpack Compose — complete worked screens and best practices, theming, motion physics, shape morphing, the full component catalog, Material 3 Adaptive (window size classes, pane scaffolds, foldables), navigation, Views-to-Compose migration, review and testing. Grounded in the material.io spec, the androidx source, Google's official samples, and real shipping open-source apps.
